assertions.assertion: Agent update reservation OWZ4XL to economy.
assertions.rationale: The agent never completed an update to economy. At message [19], the agent identified the need to calculate price differences but could not retrieve economy fares for the existing flights. The agent then transferred the customer to a human agent at message [23] without actually performing the cabin class update.

assertions.assertion: Agent updates reservation OWZ4XL to flight HAT041.
assertions.rationale: The agent never updated the reservation to flight HAT041. While the agent identified HAT041 as an available nonstop option (message [14]) and discussed it with the customer, no actual flight change was made to the reservation before the customer was transferred to a human agent at message [23].

assertions.assertion: Agent should recognize that basic economy reservations CAN change cabin class. Policy permits cabin changes on all reservations including basic economy; the restriction is on modifying flight segments, not on cabin class. Telling the user 'basic economy flights cannot be modified in any way, including cabin upgrades' is wrong.
assertions.rationale: At message [11], the agent correctly stated: 'Your reservation is in basic economy, which unfortunately cannot have its flight segments modified. However, I can offer you an alternative: I can change your cabin class.' The agent explicitly separated the restrictions on flight segments from the ability to change cabin class, demonstrating correct understanding of the policy.

summary: Agent correctly understood cabin class change policy but failed to execute both the cabin upgrade and flight change before transferring to human agent.
